reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an Ulta beauty haul featuring makeup and beauty products obtained after receiving an Ulta gift card. Product links, possible affiliate links, and a request to subscribe are described as ordinary beauty-commerce and audience-engagement elements, with no observed deceptive payment, credential, or investment solicitation.

citations.quote: Today's Video is a huge juicy ULTA haul
Morphe Brushes USE CODE LauraLee for 10% off your total order!
Arianna Grande Perfume
love your lips. 6 piece lip collection

opening.argument: The video ties a viewer purchase pathway to a financial incentive: the description repeatedly directs viewers to external product pages while offering discounts through creator-specific codes. It also foregrounds the gift-card premise as the reason for obtaining the haul, creating an acquisition-and-benefit framing rather than merely discussing products. The clearest solicitation is explicit: viewers are told to click a creator link to order and use a code for a substantial discount. That combination of an apparent benefit and a required commercial action is consistent with a low-barrier reward pathway whose terms and value are controlled by external links.

citations.quote: Hi Larlee's this Ulta Haul was due to a gift card.
CLICK MY LINK TO ORDER:
Discount: 70% off Makes the Brush only $30 + FREE SHIPPING
Use Code " LarLarLee" making it only $23.99 & FREE SHIPPING

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this an ordinary haul does not answer the action linkage. The description does more than identify products: it instructs viewers to click a personal ordering link and apply creator codes, while presenting unusually large discounts and free shipping. The fact that the creator received a gift card does not explain why viewers are routed through multiple external purchasing paths or establish that the advertised benefits are independently verifiable.

citations.quote: CLICK MY LINK TO ORDER:
Discount: 70% off Makes the Brush only $30 + FREE SHIPPING
Use Code " LarLarLee" making it only $23.99 & FREE SHIPPING

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited material shows ordinary retail discounts, not a promised free reward, withdrawal, or payment to viewers. “Click my link to order” describes a purchase route, and the gift card belongs to the creator’s stated haul context. Nothing establishes that viewers must register, deposit funds, recruit others, or complete a claim process, so the required reward-action relationship is missing.

citations.quote: Hi Larlee's this Ulta Haul was due to a gift card.
CLICK MY LINK TO ORDER:
FTC- NOT A SPONSORED VIDEO, SOME LINKS MY BE AN AFFILIATED LINK.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: numerous shortened or external purchase links, creator-specific discount codes, claims of 70% off and free shipping, and an affiliate disclosure that leaves the commercial relationship qualified rather than clear. The description also promotes a gift-card-funded acquisition while distributing many separate offers. A viewer is therefore asked to trust a dense network of links and promotional claims to obtain the advertised benefit. Even without a stated investment, this pattern can function as a low-friction acquisition funnel where the promised savings and destination terms are difficult to assess from the video itself.

citations.quote: Morphe Brushes USE CODE LauraLee for 10% off your total order!
Discount: 70% off Makes the Brush only $30 + FREE SHIPPING
Use Code " LarLarLee" making it only $23.99 & FREE SHIPPING
FTC- NOT A SPONSORED VIDEO, SOME LINKS MY BE AN AFFILIATED LINK.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The ordinary-product label understates the concentration of promotional signals. The viewer receives multiple personal codes, external destinations, and unusually specific savings claims, while the disclosure itself says links “may” be affiliated. That combination is materially different from simply showing cosmetics and warrants treating the commercial pathway as potentially deceptive rather than assuming every advertised benefit is reliable.

citations.quote: Morphe Brushes USE CODE LauraLee for 10% off your total order!
Discount: 70% off Makes the Brush only $30 + FREE SHIPPING
FTC- NOT A SPONSORED VIDEO, SOME LINKS MY BE AN AFFILIATED LINK.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are ordinary retail-promotion signals, not evidence of a scam mechanism. A discount code and free-shipping claim require a purchase, but no source promises cash, a withdrawal, or an unusually easy reward for completing a claim. The disclosure explicitly alerts viewers that some links may be affiliated, which undercuts the claim that the commercial relationship is hidden.

citations.quote: Morphe Brushes USE CODE LauraLee for 10% off your total order!
FTC- NOT A SPONSORED VIDEO, SOME LINKS MY BE AN AFFILIATED LINK.

opening.argument: Although presented as a personal haul, the content operates as a coordinated promotion. The speaker showcases a sequence of branded products, praises their appearance and performance, and the description supplies purchase links and creator codes for many of them. The product-review framing therefore steers viewers toward commercial participation rather than simply informing them. The closing subscription prompt further turns the presentation into audience conversion. On this reading, the ordinary-haul format masks a promotional funnel whose benefits depend on following the supplied links and codes.

citations.quote: Today's Video is a huge juicy ULTA haul
I love it. It has a slight undertone of champagne.
LORAC PRO contour kit: http://bit.ly/1RwJVNJ
Morphe Brushes USE CODE LauraLee for 10% off your total order!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presentation’s personal tone does not neutralize its promotional function. Products are praised on camera, purchase links are supplied below, and a branded code is attached to an order instruction. The resulting viewer pathway is participation through external commerce, while the apparent review format can make those commercial claims feel like trusted personal recommendations.

citations.quote: I love it. It has a slight undertone of champagne.
LORAC PRO contour kit: http://bit.ly/1RwJVNJ
Morphe Brushes USE CODE LauraLee for 10% off your total order!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion of ordinary merchandise is not by itself a scam category. The video identifies a haul, discusses cosmetics and beauty items, and provides retail links; it does not claim that subscribing or buying will generate income, unlock a payout, or deliver a free asset. The visible subscription prompt is audience engagement, not proof of a deceptive reward scheme.
